name: Aloft Bali Seminyak
short_description: A lifestyle-brand Aloft on Batu Belig, between Seminyak's dining and nightlife and Canggu's surf-and-cafe scene, with a rooftop infinity pool.
ai_summary: Aloft Bali Seminyak sits in Batu Belig, positioned between Seminyak's established dining, shopping, and nightlife strip and Canggu's cafe and surf culture just to the north. Rated 4 of 5 on TripAdvisor and placed in the upper-middle tier among Kerobokan Kelod's hotels, it draws consistent praise for its walkable location -- guests describe having the beach, beach clubs, bars with live music, and convenience stores all within easy reach. The rooftop infinity pool and KAHUNA Rooftop Pool & Restaurant are called out as strong features, and W XYZ Bar brings the brand's signature handcrafted cocktails to the lobby. Service is repeatedly described as personalized and attentive, with guests noting staff who go above and beyond, and the hotel's rates are frequently cited as offering excellent value relative to its location. Rooms are described as modern and spacious with the brand's signature plush bedding. The main recurring watchouts are occasional noise and maintenance issues typical of a compact, design-led select-service property in a busy nightlife-adjacent area. For travelers who want a stylish, budget-conscious lifestyle base within walking distance of both Seminyak and Canggu, it's a well-reviewed choice among Bali's Bonvoy properties.

faqs.question: Is Aloft Bali Seminyak within walking distance of the beach?
faqs.answer: Yes -- guests describe the Batu Belig location as putting the beach, beach clubs, bars, and convenience stores all within easy walking distance, alongside proximity to both Seminyak and Canggu.

faqs.question: Does Aloft Bali Seminyak have a pool?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it has a rooftop infinity pool alongside KAHUNA Rooftop Pool & Restaurant, which guest reviews consistently highlight as one of the property's strongest features, alongside the lobby's W XYZ Bar for handcrafted cocktails and evening entertainment.
